killedBy: hud.css is syntactically whole never centres the main axis of a pane that scrolls
why: Restores what the About pane actually shipped before issue #117. `justify-content: center` on an `overflow-y: auto` flex column puts the overflow ABOVE the scrollable area, where no scrollbar reaches it, so an open licence loses its first screenful with no way to scroll back up to it. Invisible to everything else: the pane still opens, every document still expands, every control is still reachable by the roving walk, and jsdom lays nothing out -- the defect is a real browser's scroll geometry. The case that kills this sweeps every `overflow-y: auto` element the fixture builds and PINS the siblings that still carry the same shape -- Settings and Developer Tools, since issue #274 fixed Versus Setup, so it fails both when the About pane regresses and when a third pane joins them. The `find` names the comment above the declaration rather than the declaration block alone: issue #599's `.hud-selftest` repeats the same five lines, and a bare declaration find became ambiguous.
